updates.fact: AKS has a scale limit of 1,000 nodes per cluster
updates.current_info: AKS supports up to 5,000 nodes per cluster.
updates.heading: ### Example scale units

updates.fact: Analytical store data is not included in Azure Cosmos DB backups
updates.current_info: Azure Cosmos DB continuous backup now includes analytical store data. Earlier documentation stated analytical store was excluded from backups, but this has been updated.
updates.heading: ### Design considerations

updates.fact: Azure CDN supports Azure WAF enablement in public preview
updates.current_info: The Microsoft Azure updates page still references WAF for Azure CDN from Microsoft as being 'in preview'. However, note that Azure CDN from Microsoft (classic) is being retired in favor of Azure Front Door, which has GA WAF support. The claim about public preview was accurate at the time but the feature/product is being deprecated.
updates.heading: ### Design considerations

updates.fact: Azure Cache for Redis offers Premium, Enterprise, and Enterprise Flash tiers
updates.current_info: Azure Cache for Redis offers Basic, Standard, Premium, Enterprise, and Enterprise Flash tiers
updates.heading: ### Design Considerations

updates.fact: Azure Database for PostgreSQL is offered in Single Server, Flexible Server, and Hyperscale (Citus) deployment options
updates.current_info: Single Server is retired (end of life March 28, 2025) and Hyperscale (Citus) has been merged into Flexible Server. The current deployment option is Flexible Server only.
updates.heading: ### Design considerations

updates.fact: Calico has a richer feature set than Azure network policies including Windows node support
updates.current_info: Azure Network Policy Manager supports both Linux and Windows Server 2022, while Calico supports Linux and Windows Server 2019/2022. Both support Windows nodes. Azure NPM is described as simpler while Calico has advanced features like egress and DNS policies, but Windows support is not unique to Calico.
updates.heading: ### Design Considerations

updates.fact: Availability Zones provide guaranteed sub-2ms inter-zone latency
updates.current_info: Azure documents a round-trip latency of less than 2ms as a design goal between Availability Zones, but it is not a guaranteed SLA commitment. The actual wording is that AZs deliver low-latency networking with round-trip latency of less than 2ms, not a guarantee.
updates.heading: ## Inter-zone and inter-region Connectivity

updates.fact: Azure Standard Load Balancer cross-region capability is available in preview and not recommended for mission-critical workloads
updates.current_info: Azure cross-region Load Balancer reached General Availability (GA) status. It is no longer merely in preview.
updates.heading: ### Design considerations

updates.fact: North Star architecture is the recommended cloud-native baseline pattern for mission-critical workloads
updates.current_info: Microsoft's mission-critical architecture documentation recommends a 'north star design approach' as part of the architecture pattern, but does not use the exact phrase 'North Star architecture' as a named pattern nor call it the 'recommended cloud-native baseline pattern'. It is a design approach within the broader mission-critical guidance.
updates.heading: #### Design considerations and recommendations for Azure Logic Apps

updates.fact: Continuous backups provide recovery points across the last 30 days for Azure Cosmos DB
updates.current_info: Azure Cosmos DB continuous backup offers two tiers: 7-day retention (default) and 30-day retention. The 30-day retention is available but not the only option.
updates.heading: ### Design Recommendations

updates.fact: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Single Server has a 99.99% SLA
updates.current_info: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Single Server reached end of life and is deprecated. Its SLA was 99.99%, but the service is no longer available for new or existing workloads, having been replaced by Flexible Server.
updates.heading: ### Design considerations

updates.fact: Continuous backup enables point-in-time restore via Azure portal or ARM templates
updates.current_info: Continuous backup restore can be triggered via Azure portal, Azure CLI, Azure PowerShell, or ARM templates. The claim is partially correct but incomplete.
updates.heading: ### Design considerations

updates.fact: Action Groups have hard limits on configurable responses
updates.current_info: Action Groups have specific numeric limits (e.g., 10 webhook actions per group, 1500 webhook calls/min/subscription, 10 email actions per group, etc.) but the 'Maximum limit' column shows 'Same as Default' — meaning these are fixed limits, not configurable.
updates.heading: ### Design considerations

updates.fact: VPN provides aggregated bandwidth up to 10 Gbps in hub-and-spoke networks
updates.current_info: The highest VPN Gateway SKU (VpnGw5) provides up to 10 Gbps aggregate throughput across all tunnels, but per-tunnel throughput maxes out at ~2.3 Gbps. The 10 Gbps figure refers to the aggregate gateway benchmark throughput for the VpnGw5 SKU, which is specific to Virtual WAN/hub scenarios. The claim about 'hub-and-spoke networks' likely conflates VPN Gateway with Azure Virtual WAN's hub VPN capability.
updates.heading: #### Connected virtual networks

updates.fact: Azure Application Gateway v2 has AI-powered threat analysis and response capabilities
updates.current_info: Azure Application Gateway v2 includes WAF capabilities but is not documented as having AI-powered threat analysis and response. AI-powered threat analysis is more associated with Azure DDoS Protection or Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
updates.heading: ### Azure feature updates

updates.fact: Azure Defender is enabled for all supporting services
updates.current_info: Azure Defender has been rebranded to Microsoft Defender for Cloud. The equivalent current recommendation would be to enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud plans for all supporting services.
updates.heading: ### Design recommendations

updates.fact: The Mission-Critical open source project is hosted on GitHub under the Azure/AlwaysOn repository
updates.current_info: The project was originally at Azure/AlwaysOn but has been renamed to Azure/Mission-Critical. Furthermore, the repository is no longer actively maintained.
updates.heading: # Security considerations for mission-critical workloads on Azure

updates.fact: Azure NetApp Files offers a Flexible service level
updates.current_info: Azure NetApp Files offers three service levels: Standard, Premium, and Ultra. There is no 'Flexible' service level.
